title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: State Theatre, Easton | 2012
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the State Theatre in Easton, Pennsylvania, USA, on 26 June 2012.

It was the tenth show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 26 dates in June and July 2012.

Starr had previously performed at the State Theatre on 30 July 2003, 11 July 2006, and 2 July 2010. He returned there on 9 September 2022.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
